attributes.description: FinOps dashboard for OVH cloud spend. Tracks gross cost, net cost after credits, credit burn rate, service cost allocation (Compute / Network / Storage / AI), per-invoice cost efficiency, and unit economics for resource optimization decisions.

embeddableConfig.content:
## OVH FinOps — Cloud Spend & Cost Optimization
💡 **FinOps lens:** Gross spend vs net cost after credits · Service cost allocation (Compute / Network / Storage / AI) · Credit burn rate · Unit economics per resource · Invoice-level cost efficiency

> **Account:** `qz2514-ovh` (Frederic Maussion) · OVH FR subsidiary · Currency: **EUR**

query.esql:
FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price > 0
| EVAL `Service Category` = CASE(
    CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "instances") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "b3-8"), "Compute",
    CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "gateway") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "floating ip") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "loadbalancer") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "octavia"), "Network",
    CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "disques") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "stockage") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "object"), "Storage",
    CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "ai endpoints") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "tokens"), "AI/ML",
    "Other"
  )
| STATS `Total Cost` = SUM(ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price) BY `Service Category`
| SORT `Total Cost` DESC

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price > 0
| EVAL `Service Category` = CASE(
    CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "instances") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "b3-8"), "Compute",
    CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "gateway") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "floating ip") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "loadbalancer") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "octavia"), "Network",
    CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "disques") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "stockage") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "object"), "Storage",
    CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "ai endpoints") OR CONTAINS(TO_LOWER(ovh.billing.bill_detail.description), "tokens"), "AI/ML",
    "Other"
  )
| STATS `Total Cost` = SUM(ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price) BY `Service Category`
| SORT `Total Cost` DESC

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price > 0
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| EVAL `Service Category` = CASE(
    ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Compute*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*instance*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*CPU*", "Compute",
    ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Network*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Gateway*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*bandwidth*", "Network",
    ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Storage*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*volume*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*backup*", "Storage",
    ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*AI*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*ML*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*model*", "AI-ML",
    "Other"
  )
| STATS `Monthly Cost` = SUM(ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price) BY `Month` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Service Category`
| SORT `Month` ASC

FROM logs-ovh_billing.bill-*
| WHERE ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price > 0
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| EVAL `Service Category` = CASE(
    ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Compute*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*instance*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*CPU*", "Compute",
    ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Network*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Gateway*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*bandwidth*", "Network",
    ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*Storage*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*volume*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*backup*", "Storage",
    ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*AI*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*ML*" OR ovh.billing.bill_detail.description LIKE "*model*", "AI-ML",
    "Other"
  )
| STATS `Monthly Cost` = SUM(ovh.billing.bill_detail.total_price) BY `Month` = BUCKET(@timestamp, 75, ?_tstart, ?_tend), `Service Category`
| SORT `Month` ASC
